---
title: "Linear Combination of Independent Normals"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "10/01/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)   # for reproducibility

# Parameters
mu1 <- 0.08    # mean of Y1
sd1 <- 0.04    # stdev of Y1
mu2 <- 0.05    # mean of Y2
sd2 <- 0.03    # stdev of Y2

a <- 0.6       # weight for Y1
b <- 0.4       # weight for Y2

n <- 100000    # number of simulations

# Simulate independent normals
Y1 <- rnorm(n, mean = mu1, sd = sd1)
Y2 <- rnorm(n, mean = mu2, sd = sd2)

# Linear combination
W <- a*Y1 + b*Y2

# Theoretical mean and sd
theo_mean <- a*mu1 + b*mu2
theo_sd   <- sqrt((a^2)*sd1^2 + (b^2)*sd2^2)

# Empirical mean and sd
emp_mean <- mean(W)
emp_sd   <- sd(W)

cat("Theoretical mean:", round(theo_mean,4), "\n")
cat("Empirical mean:", round(emp_mean,4), "\n")
cat("Theoretical SD:", round(theo_sd,4), "\n")
cat("Empirical SD:", round(emp_sd,4), "\n")

# Create data frame for plotting
df <- data.frame(W = W)

# Histogram with theoretical density overlay
ggplot(df, aes(x=W)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),
                 bins = 50, fill="skyblue", color="white", alpha=0.6) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,
                args = list(mean=theo_mean, sd=theo_sd),
                color="black", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Distribution of Portfolio Return (Linear Combination of Normals)",
       subtitle=paste0("W = 0.6Y1 + 0.4Y2,  Theoretical N(",
                       round(theo_mean,3), ", ", round(theo_sd,3), "^2)"),
       x="W (Portfolio Return)", y="Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)

```
